huong: I am + tính từ/nghề/nơi chốn: I am tired, I am a teacher, I am at home. Che 'am'. Đổi phần sau.

ten: Anh ấy, cô ấy, họ là (is / are)
huong: He is / She is / They are / We are / You are + tính từ. Che is/are. Đổi người.
I am not / She is not / They aren't / It isn't + tính từ. Che 'not' hoặc be.

ten: Có phải ... không? (Are you / Is she)
huong: Câu hỏi Are you tired? Is she at home? Is it far? Che Are/Is.

ten: Cái này, cái kia (this / that / these / those)
huong: This is my phone. That is your bag. These are my keys. Che this/these/that/those, chọn theo số ít, số nhiều.

ten: Của tôi, của bạn (my / your / his / her)
huong: This is my car. That is her phone. Che my/your/his/her/our/their.
I have a car. She has an apple. Che a/an.
I have a car. She has a dog. They have two kids. Che have/has.
one cat / two cats / three boxes / many people. Che danh từ số nhiều.
I want water. I want a coffee. She wants a new phone. Che want/wants.

ten: Tôi muốn làm (want to + động từ)
huong: I want to drink tea. She wants to go home. Che 'to' hoặc want/wants.
I like coffee. He likes football. We love this place. Che like/likes.

ten: Hằng ngày tôi làm (thì hiện tại)
huong: I work every day. She works at a bank. They live in Hanoi. Che động từ.
I don't eat meat. She doesn't drink coffee. Che don't/doesn't hoặc động từ sau nó.

ten: Bạn có ... không? (Do you / Does she)
huong: Do you like tea? Does she work here? Che Do/Does hoặc động từ.
There is a bank near here. There are two rooms. Che is/are.
Is there a toilet here? Are there any eggs? Che Is/Are.
Where is the toilet? Where are my keys? Where do you live? Che is/are/do.
What is this? What is your name? What do you want? Che is/do.
How much is this? How much are these shoes? Che is/are.
Can I have a coffee, please? Can I have the bill? Che 'have' hoặc a/the.

ten: Bạn có thể ... giúp tôi không? (Can you)
huong: Can you help me? Can you open the door? Che động từ sau can.

ten: Tôi biết / không biết làm (can / can't)
huong: I can swim. She can't drive. Che động từ (không to).
I am cooking. She is sleeping. They are watching TV. Che be hoặc V-ing.

ten: Bạn đang làm gì? (What are you doing)
huong: What are you doing? Is she working now? Che be hoặc V-ing.
Let's go. Let's eat now. Let's take a taxi. Che động từ sau let's.
Please sit down. Don't worry. Don't touch it. Che động từ.
I need a taxi. I need to call my boss. She needs help. Che need/needs/to.
I have to go now. She has to work today. Che have/has/to.
at 7 o'clock, on Monday, in May, in the morning. Che giới từ.
I am at home. The keys are on the table. She is in the kitchen. Che giới từ.
It is hot today. It is ten o'clock. It is far from here. Che 'It' hoặc 'is'.

ten: Tôi, anh ấy làm tân ngữ (me / him / her / them)
huong: Call me. Help her. I love them. Che đại từ.
This is Lan's car. My mom's house is big. Che danh từ có 's.

ten: Nhà to, xe mới (tính từ trước danh từ)
huong: a big house, a new car, a good idea. Che cụm tính từ + danh từ, đáp án nhiễu đảo trật tự.
It is very hot. This bag is too big. She is so kind. Che very/too.

ten: Một ít, nhiều (some / a lot of / many / much)
huong: I have some money. There are a lot of people. How much water? Che some/many/much.

ten: Chào hỏi, cảm ơn, xin lỗi (câu quen)
huong: Nice to meet you. Thank you very much. I'm sorry. Excuse me. See you tomorrow. Che một chữ trong câu quen.

ten: Nói lại giúp tôi (khi không hiểu)
huong: Sorry, can you say that again? Can you speak slowly, please? What does this mean? Che một chữ.

ten: Mấy giờ, khi nào (What time / When)
huong: What time is it? What time do you start work? When is your birthday? Che is/do.

ten: Hôm qua tôi đã (quá khứ đuôi ed)
huong: Yesterday I worked late. We visited my parents. Che động từ quá khứ.

ten: Hôm qua tôi đã đi, đã ăn (quá khứ đặc biệt)
huong: I went to the market. She bought a new bag. We ate pho. Che động từ quá khứ bất quy tắc.
I didn't go to work. She didn't call me. Che didn't hoặc động từ sau nó.
Did you eat? Did she call you? Che Did hoặc động từ.
I was tired. They were at home. Was it expensive? Che was/were.
I will call you. It will rain tomorrow. She will be late. Che will hoặc động từ sau.
I am going to visit my mom. We are going to buy a house. Che going/to/be.
I'd like a coffee. I'd like to book a room. Che like/to.

ten: Bạn có muốn ... không? (Would you like)
huong: Would you like some tea? Would you like to come? Che like/to/some.
You should rest. You shouldn't drink so much. Che động từ sau should.

ten: Làm ơn có thể ... không (Could you)
huong: Could you help me? Could you send me the file? Che động từ.

ten: Lớn hơn, rẻ hơn (so sánh hơn)
huong: This house is bigger. That car is more expensive. Che tính từ so sánh.
It is the biggest room. This is the most expensive car. Che cụm so sánh nhất.
My house is as big as yours. He is not as tall as me. Che as hoặc tính từ.

ten: Luôn luôn, thường, không bao giờ
huong: I always get up early. She is never late. Che trạng từ tần suất hoặc động từ cạnh nó.

ten: Bao lâu một lần, bao lâu (How often / How long)
huong: How often do you go to the gym? How long does it take? Che do/does.
It takes 10 minutes to walk there. It took two hours. Che takes/took.
I am tired because I worked late. It rained, so I stayed home. Che because/so.
I like tea but my wife likes coffee. Che but/and/or.
If it rains, I will stay home. If you call me, I will come. Che động từ ở vế if hoặc will.
When I get home, I will call you. When she is free, she reads. Che động từ.
I like it too. I don't know either. Me too. Che too/either.
I enjoy cooking. She likes reading. Che V-ing.
I finished working at 6. Stop talking, please. Che V-ing.

ten: Định, hy vọng, cố (plan / hope / try to)
huong: I plan to open a shop. I hope to see you soon. Che to hoặc động từ.

ten: Muốn ai làm gì (want you to)
huong: I want you to come. She asked me to wait. Che đại từ hoặc to.

ten: Cảm ơn vì đã (Thank you for + ing)
huong: Thank you for helping me. Thank you for coming. Che V-ing.

ten: Trước khi, sau khi (before / after + ing)
huong: Wash your hands before eating. After finishing work, I go home. Che V-ing.

ten: Trông, nghe có vẻ (look / sound / feel + tính từ)
huong: You look tired. That sounds good. I feel better. Che tính từ hoặc động từ.
It is getting cold. I got angry. Che getting/got.
I think it is a good idea. I don't think she is home. Che think hoặc is.

ten: Ai, cái nào, tại sao, thế nào (Who / Which / Why / How)
huong: Who is that man? Which one do you want? Why are you late? How do you go to work? Che từ để hỏi.
You are from Hanoi, right? It's cold, isn't it? Che isn't/aren't/right.
There was a big storm. There were many people. Che was/were.
I used to live in Dalat. She used to smoke. Che used/to.
It may rain. She might be at home. Che động từ sau may/might.
You must wear a helmet. You mustn't park here. Che động từ.

ten: Một vài, một chút (a few / a little)
huong: I have a few friends here. Can I have a little sugar? Che few/little.
I bought a car. The car is red. Please close the door. Che a/the.
I make breakfast. She does the dishes. Can you do me a favor? Che make/do.

ten: Cái gì đó, không có gì (something / anything / nothing)
huong: I want something to eat. I don't need anything. Nothing happened. Che từ đó.

ten: Đang làm lúc đó (was / were + ing)
huong: I was cooking when you called. They were sleeping. Che was/were hoặc V-ing.
Whose bag is this? It's mine. Is this yours? Che mine/yours/hers.
I am bored. The movie is boring. She is interested in art. Che tính từ ed/ing.
She drives carefully. Please speak slowly. He works hard. Che trạng từ.

ten: Bật, tìm, dậy (động từ cụm quen)
huong: Turn on the light. I am looking for my keys. I get up at 6. Che chữ nhỏ đi kèm.
Have you ever been to Japan? I have never eaten sushi. Che have/been/eaten.

ten: Vừa xong, đã ... rồi (already / just / yet)
huong: I have just finished. She has already left. Have you eaten yet? Che has/have hoặc dạng thứ ba.
I have lived here for ten years. She has worked here since 2020. Che for/since.
This phone is made in Vietnam. English is spoken here. Che is/are hoặc dạng thứ ba.

ten: Đã được làm (bị động quá khứ)
huong: The house was built in 2010. My car was stolen. Che was/were hoặc dạng thứ ba.

ten: Người mà, cái mà (who / which / that)
huong: The man who called is my boss. The car that I bought is red. Che who/which/that.
This is the place where I was born. Che where/when.

ten: Nếu tôi là (If + quá khứ, would)
huong: If I had more time, I would learn Japanese. If I were you, I would wait. Che had/were/would.
You should have told me. I should have left earlier. Che have hoặc dạng thứ ba.
I wish I had a car. I wish it were sunny. Che động từ quá khứ.

ten: Hỏi lịch sự (Can you tell me where ... is)
huong: Can you tell me where the station is? Do you know what time it opens? Che is/opens.
It is too hot to go out. She is old enough to drive. Che too/enough/to.
It was so hot that I stayed home. It was such a good day. Che so/such.
I am used to getting up early. She is used to the cold. Che V-ing hoặc be.

ten: Việc làm gì đó là (V-ing làm chủ ngữ)
huong: Swimming is good for you. Learning English takes time. Che V-ing.

ten: Đang làm suốt từ (have been + ing)
huong: I have been waiting for an hour. She has been working all day. Che been/V-ing.

ten: Cả hai, không cái nào (both / either / neither)
huong: Both rooms are nice. Neither of them is here. Che both/either/neither.
The more you practice, the better you get. Che more/better.

ten: Có vẻ như, dường như (seem to)
huong: She seems to be tired. It seems like a good plan. Che seems/to.

ten: Nhờ người khác làm (have / get something done)
huong: I had my car washed. I need to get my hair cut. Che dạng thứ ba.

ten: Kể lại lời nói (said that / told me)
huong: She said that she was busy. He told me to wait. Che said/told/was.

ten: Hỏi xem có ... không (ask if / whether)
huong: She asked if I was free. I don't know whether he will come. Che if/was/will.
Although it was late, we kept working. Che although/but.
I came here to see you. I saved money so that I could buy a house. Che to/so/could.
I'd rather stay home. I prefer tea to coffee. Che rather/prefer/to.
She must be tired. That can't be true. Che be.

ten: Bỏ, tìm ra, trả lại (động từ cụm nâng cao)
huong: I gave up smoking. I found out the truth. Please give it back. Che chữ nhỏ đi kèm.

ten: Đề nghị, gợi ý (How about / Why don't we)
huong: How about going out tonight? Why don't we take a break? Che going/take.
